privacy:
Last Updated: November 13, 2026

By using Cozine, you agree to this Privacy Policy and our Terms of Service. Please read both documents carefully. If you do not agree, do not install or use the bot.

1. How We Collect Information

All information is collected through public data and platform integration:

  • Discord Platform Data - We access publicly accessible member data, presence information, and shared security logs within monitored servers.
  • Roblox Public API - Public profile information to verify Roblox account status.
  • Account Linking Services - Third-party services that link Roblox accounts to Discord identities.

2. What We Collect

  • User IDs - Unique Discord identifiers
  • Guild IDs - Server identifiers
  • Roblox Account IDs - Unique Roblox identifiers linked to documented activity
  • Security Logs - Records of violations and exploit activity

3. How We Use Data

Data is used strictly to keep communities safe and identify users in violation of Discord or Roblox Terms of Service. This includes:

  • Checking new members against records of verified ToS violators
  • Sending alerts to moderators about potential threats
  • Keeping records of security violations

4. Command Error Logs

When a command fails, Cozine may collect error logs to help improve the bot and fix bugs. These logs are stored server side on our own infrastructure and are only used to diagnose and fix bugs in Cozine , they are never used for profiling, marketing, or shared with third parties.

Logs can contain error details and, if you choose, your Discord user ID. You can turn error logging on or off at any time using the /privacy command. The same command also lets you choose whether your user ID is included in error logs when logging is enabled. Error logs are deleted on request thru the support server or by creating a ticket in the panel.

5. Age Requirement

Discord requires users to be at least 13 years old. We do not verify age and do not ask for it. If we learn that a user is under 13, we will terminate them from using our services and delete their data from our systems, including security logs and error logs, unless we are legally required to keep it.

6. Data Retention & Deletion

We will delete your data upon request. We retain records of users documented to have violated Discord or Roblox Terms of Service, so that repeat offenders can be detected. These records are kept for up to 24 months from the most recent documented violation, after which we check whether the record is still needed and delete it if it is not. If you believe you were flagged in error, you can file an appeal (see Contact below) and we will review your case. If an appeal is approved, one of two things happens, depending on the case:
Data deletion: the record is deleted and the user is no longer flagged.
Whitelist: the user is whitelisted, the record is kept, and the user may use the bot. Whitelisting is at the discretion of the bot owners.

We recognize that security researchers or investigators may occasionally be flagged. If you believe your data was logged in error, you can easily file an appeal (see Contact below). Each case is reviewed manually.

7. Data Retention Periods

  • Flagged-user records - Kept for up to 24 months from the most recent documented violation, then checked and deleted if no longer needed. Deleted earlier if a successful appeal is granted or if we learn the user is under 13.
  • Whitelisted records - Kept until the bot owners remove the whitelist. Whitelisted users may still trigger alerts to servers that have set up Cozine.
  • Security logs - Kept while relevant to moderation and open appeals.
  • Command error logs - Kept only while relevant to fixing bugs, and deleted on request.

8. Data Storage

  • Stored on secure servers with restricted access
  • Access is strictly limited to bot administrators
  • We may share your data with third parties only for the purposes described in this policy here, and we will never sell it.

9. Contact

For questions, data deletion requests, or to file an appeal, join our support server or open a support ticket in the panel.
tos:
Last Updated: November 13, 2026

By using Cozine, you agree to these Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy. Please read both documents carefully. If you do not agree, do not install or use the bot.

1. What Cozine Does

Cozine monitors Discord servers and flags Roblox exploiters who join them.

Servers can opt-in to receive automated notifications using the designated setup command. When a flagged user joins a configured server, moderators will receive an alert. We are not responsible for individual server ban decisions. Moderators make the final call on whether to take action.

2. Exclusive Access & Account Terms

There is no paid tier. Exclusive access is granted to moderators of large games or Discord servers with a clean record. By holding exclusive access, you explicitly agree to the following terms:

  • Strict Restrictions: You may use the bot to alert your server moderators, but you are strictly prohibited from using it to harass, threaten, dox, or incite action against them.
  • No Tampering: You may not reverse engineer, bypass, or attempt to bypass the bot's restrictions, limitations, or protections.
  • No Facilitation: You are prohibited from helping exploiters evade detection or avoid consequences.
  • Eligibility: Access requires moderating a large game or Discord server and having no exploit-server history or bad record. If you believe you were flagged in error, you can appeal (see Contact below).
  • Account Locking: Exclusive access is bound to your Discord account and is non-transferable, except in cases of account compromise or permanent deletion with verified evidence provided, at our sole discretion.
  • Revocation: Violating any of these rules will result in immediate termination of access.

3. Accuracy & Appeals

Flags are based on documented evidence. However, if you believe you were flagged in error, you can appeal (see Contact below). Appeals are typically reviewed within 48 hours during normal operations. Response times may take longer (up to several weeks) only during high-volume periods. See our Privacy Policy for the full appeals process.

4. Acceptable Use

  • Use the bot only for legitimate server moderation and safety
  • Do not use the bot to harass, target, or discriminate against users
  • Respect Discord and Roblox Terms of Service when using this bot
  • Do not attempt to manipulate or abuse the alert system

5. Prohibited Actions

  • Using the bot outside of moderation purposes
  • Attempting to reverse engineer or extract data
  • Sharing false reports to get users flagged

6. Service Disclaimer

Cozine is provided "as-is" without guaranteed uptime. We are not liable for:

  • Server disruptions or downtime
  • Missed threats or exploiters we fail to detect
  • Actions taken by moderators based on bot alerts

7. Eligibility

  • Must be 13+ years old (Discord's minimum age)
  • Must comply with Discord's Terms of Service

8. Flagged Users

Any user flagged by Cozine is automatically restricted from using the bot. This restriction remains in effect until the user files an appeal (see Contact below) and the appeal is approved. Flagged users attempting to use the bot will be unable to access its features.

9. Termination

We reserve the right to revoke access to Cozine at any time for:

  • Violating these Terms of Service
  • Abuse of the alert system or appeals process
  • Using the bot outside of legitimate moderation purposes
  • Harassment or targeting of users

10. Changes to Terms

We may update these Terms of Service at any time. We will notify users of significant changes through our support server. Your continued use of Cozine after changes constitute acceptance of the updated terms.

11. Agreement & Privacy

For information about how we collect, store, and use data, see our Privacy Policy.

12. Contact

For questions, appeals, or other concerns, join our support server or open a support ticket in the panel.
api-tos:
Last Updated: September 12, 2026

By using the Cozine API, you agree to our main Terms of Service plus the additional terms below. If you don't agree, don't use it.

1. Access

API access is not open to everyone. API keys are granted on request (see Contact below). We review requests individually and can deny or revoke access for any reason. There is no payment involved - access is granted at our discretion.

2. Keys

  • Your key is tied to your Discord account. Do not share it.
  • If your key is leaked or compromised, notify us immediately so we can rotate it.
  • Sharing, selling, or publicly posting your key may result in immediate revocation of access.

3. Rate Limits

  • Every key has a request limit. If you exceed it, you will receive a 429 response and must wait before making more requests.
  • Deliberately bypassing limits (for example, by using multiple keys or distributing requests across accounts) may result in access being revoked.

4. Permitted Use

  • Access data for your own guilds
  • Look up user records for legitimate moderation purposes
  • Build tools or integrations that comply with these terms and our other policies

5. Prohibited Use

  • Bulk scraping or exporting data for unrelated purposes
  • Reselling or redistributing the data
  • Using the API to target, harass, dox, or harm anyone
  • Attempting to reverse engineer or bypass the API or its protections
  • Using the API for purposes other than legitimate moderation and safety

6. Data

  • We don't sell your data.
  • For data deletion and appeals, see our Privacy Policy

7. Downtime & Liability

The API may experience downtime or interruptions. We are not liable for:

  • Outages, delays, or slow responses
  • Issues with tools or services you build that are affected by an outage or change

8. Termination

We may revoke or suspend your API access at any time if you violate these terms. If you believe a decision was made in error, you can contact us (see Contact below).

9. Changes

We may update these terms at any time. If there are significant changes, we will post an announcement in the support server. Continued use of the API after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

10. Contact

To request an API key, dispute a decision, or ask anything: support server or open a support ticket in the panel.
